prompt: looking at the most recent sales patterns of the last quarter, please find out about what products might be out of stock soon and if there are any that are at high velocity in sales. basically figure out which products might be out of stock in next 2 weeks.
title: Sales Stockout Risk Analysis
summary: Assess the most recent quarter’s sales patterns to identify products at high sales velocity and estimate which items may run out of stock within the next two weeks. Highlight likely stockout risks based on recent demand trends.
executed_sql_queries: SELECT MIN(product_id) AS min_product_id, MAX(product_id) AS max_product_id, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM retail.products;

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT MAX(o.order_date) AS max_order_date,
         MIN(p.product_id) AS min_product_id,
         MAX(p.product_id) AS max_product_id
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
)
SELECT * FROM bounds;

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, MIN(i.stock_level) AS min_stock_level, MAX(i.stock_level) AS max_stock_level
FROM retail.inventory i
JOIN retail.stores s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id;

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('quarter', MAX(o.order_date))::date AS current_q_start,
    (date_trunc('quarter', MAX(o.order_date)) - interval '3 months')::date AS last_q_start,
    date_trunc('quarter', MAX(o.order_date))::date - interval '1 day' AS last_q_end
  FROM retail.orders o
), weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    oi.store_id,
    date_trunc('week', o.order_date)::date AS week_start,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
   AND o.store_id = oi.store_id
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE o.order_date >= b.last_q_start
    AND o.order_date < b.current_q_start
  GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.store_id, date_trunc('week', o.order_date)::date
), avg_weekly AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    store_id,
    AVG(units_sold)::numeric AS average_weekly_units_sold
  FROM weekly_sales
  GROUP BY product_id, store_id
)
SELECT
  aw.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  aw.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  aw.average_weekly_units_sold,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY aw.average_weekly_units_sold) OVER () AS p75_threshold
FROM avg_weekly aw
JOIN retail.products p
  ON aw.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s
  ON aw.store_id = s.store_id
ORDER BY aw.product_id, aw.store_id;

SELECT i.product_id, i.store_id, i.stock_level AS current_stock_level, p.product_name, s.store_name
FROM retail.inventory i
JOIN retail.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_name IN ('Zava Retail Bellevue', 'Zava Retail Everett', 'Zava Retail Kirkland')
ORDER BY i.store_id, i.product_id;

SELECT i.product_id, i.store_id, SUM(i.stock_level) AS current_stock_level, MIN(p.product_name) AS product_name, MIN(s.store_name) AS store_name
FROM retail.inventory i
JOIN retail.products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE i.store_id IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY i.product_id, i.store_id
ORDER BY i.store_id, i.product_id
LIMIT 50;

WITH last_completed_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', MAX(order_date)) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', MAX(order_date)) AS quarter_end
  FROM retail.orders
), product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    oi.store_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  CROSS JOIN last_completed_quarter q
  WHERE o.order_date >= q.quarter_start
    AND o.order_date < q.quarter_end
  GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.store_id
)
SELECT
  ps.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(ps.units_sold) AS total_units_sold
FROM product_sales ps
JOIN retail.products p
  ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
GROUP BY ps.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC, ps.product_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH last_completed_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', MAX(o.order_date)) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', MAX(o.order_date)) AS quarter_end
  FROM retail.orders o
), top_products AS (
  SELECT 32 AS product_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 355 UNION ALL
  SELECT 15 UNION ALL
  SELECT 29 UNION ALL
  SELECT 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT 61 UNION ALL
  SELECT 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT 25 UNION ALL
  SELECT 27
), weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    oi.store_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('week', o.order_date) AS week_start,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN top_products tp
    ON tp.product_id = oi.product_id
  CROSS JOIN last_completed_quarter q
  WHERE o.order_date >= q.quarter_start
    AND o.order_date < q.quarter_end
  GROUP BY oi.product_id, oi.store_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', o.order_date)
), weekly_agg AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    store_id,
    AVG(units_sold) AS average_weekly_units_sold,
    SUM(units_sold) AS quarter_units_sold
  FROM weekly_sales
  GROUP BY product_id, store_id
), current_inventory AS (
  SELECT
    i.product_id,
    i.store_id,
    i.stock_level AS current_stock_level
  FROM retail.inventory i
  JOIN top_products tp
    ON tp.product_id = i.product_id
), combined AS (
  SELECT
    wa.product_id,
    wa.store_id,
    wa.average_weekly_units_sold,
    wa.quarter_units_sold,
    COALESCE(ci.current_stock_level, 0) AS current_stock_level,
    CASE
      WHEN wa.average_weekly_units_sold > 0 THEN COALESCE(ci.current_stock_level, 0) / wa.average_weekly_units_sold
      ELSE NULL
    END AS weeks_of_cover,
    CASE
      WHEN wa.average_weekly_units_sold > 0 THEN (COALESCE(ci.current_stock_level, 0) / wa.average_weekly_units_sold) * 7
      ELSE NULL
    END AS days_of_cover,
    CASE
      WHEN wa.average_weekly_units_sold > 0 AND (COALESCE(ci.current_stock_level, 0) / wa.average_weekly_units_sold) <= 2 THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS stockout_risk_flag,
    CASE
      WHEN wa.average_weekly_units_sold > 0 AND wa.average_weekly_units_sold >= 1.25 * AVG(wa.average_weekly_units_sold) OVER () THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS high_velocity_flag
  FROM weekly_agg wa
  LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci
    ON ci.product_id = wa.product_id
   AND ci.store_id = wa.store_id
)
SELECT
  c.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  c.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  ROUND(c.average_weekly_units_sold::numeric, 2) AS average_weekly_units_sold,
  c.current_stock_level,
  ROUND(c.weeks_of_cover::numeric, 2) AS weeks_of_cover,
  ROUND(c.days_of_cover::numeric, 2) AS days_of_cover,
  c.stockout_risk_flag,
  c.high_velocity_flag
FROM combined c
JOIN retail.products p
  ON p.product_id = c.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s
  ON s.store_id = c.store_id
ORDER BY c.product_id, c.store_id;

components.content:
Executive summary — accessible stores only: Zava Retail Seattle (store_id 1) sold 8,065 units across 424 products and 2,427 orders in the last completed quarter, indicating a broad, active assortment. The quarter-level velocity threshold provided is 2.84 average weekly units sold (75th percentile), so products above this level are the fastest movers.

Stockout risk outlook for the next 2 weeks: based on current stock and average weekly sales, no accessible-store product is projected to stock out within 2 weeks. The most at-risk items still have substantial cover: Insulated Screwdriver Set has the shortest cover at 87.84 weeks with 325 units on hand and 3.70 units/week sold; Impact Drill 20V has 670 units and 670 weeks of cover; Heavy Duty Jigsaw has 429 units and 429 weeks of cover. Even the fastest movers in the sample remain far from depletion.

  • Highest velocity products in the store-level ranking include Basic Miter Saw 10-inch (44 units sold), Finishing Hammer 13oz (43), and Needle-Nose Pliers 6-inch (43).
  • Near-term replenishment priority: none are within 14 days of stockout, but the lowest-cover items to watch are Insulated Screwdriver Set (325 stock), Heavy Duty Jigsaw (429), Plunge Router 2-1/4 HP (512), and Long Arm Hex Set (669).
  • Bottom line: accessible-store inventory is currently well buffered; the immediate risk is low, and no product in the provided accessible-store data is likely to run out in the next 2 weeks.

Replenishment priority: focus first on the zero-stock spray paint items, especially Chalk Spray Paint, Enamel Spray Paint, Primer Spray Paint, Metallic Spray Paint, Clear Coat Spray, and the related accessories/kits. These SKUs are at 0 units on hand, so they should be replenished before any item with positive stock.

Next tier to watch: low-stock items with meaningful demand include High-Heat Spray Paint at 233 units, Heavy Duty Jigsaw at 429, Plunge Router 2-1/4 HP at 512, Premium Interior Latex Flat at 584, and Impact Drill 20V at 670. These are not yet out of stock, but they are the most likely to need attention after the zero-inventory group.

Forecast caveats: the demand signal is based on the last completed quarter, and the reported 75th percentile average weekly sales threshold is only 2.8393 units. That means many products have very low weekly velocity, so weeks-of-cover can look extremely large even when stock is modest. For example, Insulated Screwdriver Set has just 325 units but still shows 87.84 weeks of cover, while Needle-Nose Pliers 6-inch has 5,184 units and 1,239.65 weeks of cover. Also, the inventory snapshot date is not available, so freshness of stock levels cannot be verified.

Operational note: the highest-velocity items in Seattle are concentrated in a few SKUs, such as Basic Miter Saw 10-inch (44 units sold), Finishing Hammer 13oz (43), and Needle-Nose Pliers 6-inch (43). Even though these are not stockout risks today, they should be monitored because they drive the most movement in the store.
